title: Grateful Dead Live at Ohio Theatre on 1971-10-31
lineage: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition CC2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a legendary Halloween show – fresh Keith, smoking Dark Star/Deal and a second‑set that ignites the night.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a high‑energy October 31, 1971 performance with crisp, incendiary soundboard quality. Reviewers rave about the fresh Keith on keyboards, Jerry’s soaring guitar tone, and a second set that delivers Dark Star, Deal, Playing in the Band and a blistering Not Fade Away/Going Down the Road jam. Minor channel‑swap quirks are noted but do not detract from an overall superb listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are strongly positive (4–5 ★), praising both the musical performance and the soundboard recording; only minor technical notes appear, so a high rating with strong confidence is warranted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Incendiary, crisp mix with clear instrument separation. Some reviewers mention channel‑swap quirks and a needed pitch correction on J.B. Goode, but overall the sound is clean and well balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid and varied; second set fires on all cylinders with a monster Dark Star opening and seamless transitions that keep the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His tone is praised as 'perfect' and he 'takes off the best he can' after the mix settles.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith is highlighted repeatedly as fresh, great, and a key factor in the show's strength.
